notes: Analyst pass: (1) Baseline is near-ceiling — the session model routes skills well without help, so pass-rate delta is small (+8pp from one assertion). The skill's visible value is decisiveness and structure: with-skill outputs commit to one primary pick with an explicit ordered verdict; the eval-0 baseline hedged (primary + co-primary + 3 optionals, two alternative combos, pick deferred to user). (2) Assertions 1-3 on every eval passed in all configurations — non-discriminating as written; only 'explicit verdict line' discriminated. Next iteration should either add assertions targeting decisiveness (single primary pick, bounded plan length, no unresolved either/or) or accept that this skill's value is qualitative consistency, not raw accuracy. (3) With-skill runs cost slightly more tokens/time (skill read overhead ~2-4k tokens, +15-25s) — expected. (4) eval-1 (no-skill verdict) shows both configs resist over-routing; keep it as a regression guard.
